entities.name: Mansa Musa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emperor of the Mali Empire (r. 1312–1337), often cited as the wealthiest individual in history. His 1324 pilgrimage to Mecca — distributing so much gold that he crashed the Egyptian economy for a decade — demonstrated Mali's extraordinary wealth and placed West Africa firmly on the world stage. He built the Djinguereber Mosque and the University of Sankore in Timbuktu.
